christians-reading-classics.title: Mere Christianity by C.S. Lewis, with Daniel K. Williams
christians-reading-classics.description: In this episode, we explore the enduring power of C.S. Lewis's 'Mere Christianity' and its place in the broader history of Christian apologetics. Daniel K. Williams, a historian and expert in apologetics, shares insights into what makes a work of apologetics a classic, how Lewis's work has influenced generations, and the evolving landscape of Christian defense strategies.
